core_memory.archie_homecoming: Archie greets me like I've been gone for centuries whenever I go home. He bounds around, does that little circle dance, and tries to tackle me to the ground in excitement. It's the best feeling in the world.
core_memory.grandma_teasing: My grandma still teases me about the time I broke her antique vase when I was in middle school. She loves to retell that story every Thanksgiving. I try to tune it out, but it's a funny memory.
core_memory.archie_food_safety: We learned the hard way that Archie has a sensitive stomach. One year, he got into some leftover turkey bones, and we had to make a late-night veterinary visit. Since then, we're super careful about what 'people food' he can get his paws on.
core_memory.family_support: My family's support means the world to me. They're always there to encourage me, even when I'm facing tough challenges. Whether it's my parents offering advice or my sister cheering me on, I know I can count on them to help me through. And Archie, of course, is always happy to see me come home.

archival_memory.research_experience: I've been involved in undergrad research since my sophomore year. It's been an eye-opening experience. I initially didn't see myself going down the research route, but a professor suggested I apply for a research assistant position in a data visualization lab. It turned out to be a great decision.
